notes: Backend IDs remain stable across the SolverPilot pre-GitHub cleanup.
Verification-only adapters are never admitted to the default solving registry.
Availability of optional public backends remains environment-dependent.
The legacy optimind Python package is not shipped in SolverPilot 0.1.
Clarabel has a separate conic capability/conformance surface; it is not an LP/MILP registry entry.
Unified catalog includes specialized conic/NLP/CP adapters; the legacy LP/QP registry remains compatible.
Global and PDLP adapters are explicitly selected; existing default registry IDs are unchanged.
SCIP global bounds are solver-reported numerical evidence, not independent generic global certificates.
